scope: Offline contract mapping, deterministic portable ZIP and extraction into new marker-owned fixture directories. This is not a second installer or an installed-state authority.
preconditions: Source-bound clean native build identity and independently enumerated nonempty staging inventory before packaging.
Quiescent ordinary local regular files; links, remote/device namespaces, unsafe names and collisions refuse.
Explicit new fixture workspace and explicit new output child; existing empty or occupied roots refuse without changes.

package_mapping.source: usk.source_manifest.v1 local_package binds payload.zip byte count and raw hex SHA-256.
package_mapping.components: One disked.prototype component maps every independent inventory file to file/path/integer bytes/raw hex SHA-256; windows/x64.
package_mapping.external_state: Configuration, cases, journals, evidence and recovery are external to the immutable payload, never bundled or owned by this fixture.
package_mapping.release_eligibility: Unavailable: owner license, complete notices, signatures and channel/target qualification remain separate. Empty references make no qualification claim.

recipe_mapping.contract: usk.setup_recipe.v1; authored requirements, not a callable lifecycle request or permission.
recipe_mapping.installed_state_compatibility: Schema reference 1.0 only, no reader qualification.

expected_results: Assembled payload ZIP contains exactly inventory paths and bytes; each package component and immutable path agrees with that inventory.
Package and recipe validate against five exact unmodified pinned upstream schemas using an offline reference registry.

Verification and extraction require separately selected inventory and build-info inputs; a wholly replaced internally consistent bundle cannot redefine expected bytes. They reject missing/extra/changed metadata or payload, mismatched product/version/component/digest/topology, stale source locks and unsupported mode claims.
Extracted ordinary fixture files equal the independent inventory and original payload, including the one disked.exe entrypoint.
Existing empty/occupied/file/link roots refuse without overwrite or deletion; generated foreign, case, recovery and evidence bytes remain exact.
A write failure retains partial fixture output for inspection; no automatic cleanup, retry, install record, host integration or rollback claim.
Checksums establish equality only. Real Setup ABI integration, live lifecycle, authenticity, other targets and owner acceptance remain not_run.
qualification: Fixture-only; no physical access, network acquisition, SDK execution, installation, registry/PATH/shortcuts/services, elevation, signing or publication. Quiescent fixture ownership is a test boundary, not isolation from hostile concurrent filesystem mutation.
